name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
storyline:
Beyond your choice, will there be salvation or corruption?
Lucifer, the angel most beloved by God, was cast out of the Celestial Realm following a rebellion. Along with his brothers, he fell to the lowest depths of Hell, the prison known as Cocytus.

The question remains whether his soul is truly divine or damned.

To determine the truth, Lord Diavolo, the Prince of the Devildom, summons a lone human to judge him as a magistrate. At the end of the story, a single choice awaits regarding whether you will save him or break him.

In this world, love is not salvation. It is judgment.
summary: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.
